dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part III
dialogues.text: "...Specialist Bogdana has discovered that the black-colored mud is still constantly propagating. We have to move more swiftly than before..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part III
dialogues.text: "...The anomalous shifts in The Chasm's underground have been gradually increasing in speed. We have to bring the Mokosh Device to the bottom for assembly as soon as possible..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part III
dialogues.text: "...Fourrier Anton reports that a woman has been following us around. We might need to set up some traps and early warning systems..."
